edits.old: Then generation holds and a task goes to the litigation officer (R-LIT-04)
edits.new:
Then generation holds and a task goes to the litigation officer (R-LIT-04)

  Scenario: AC3 The rules with no other criterion hold: an uploader does not approve its own version, a body is not changed in place, a withdrawn version is not made Approved again, and no other service table is read or written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a version uploaded by the user who would approve it
    When that user approves it
    Then the approval is refused and no version changes state

  Scenario: AC4 A call without a valid session is answered 401, a call without the right is answered 403 and a call for an unknown template is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a call to an operation of this story without a valid session
    When the call is made
    Then the answer is 401
    Given a call to an operation without the right of that operation
    When the call is made
    Then the answer is 403
    Given a call for a template that does not exist
    When the call is made
    Then the answer is 404

  Scenario: AC5 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key returns the first answer and changes nothing again (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write made with an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with that key
    Then the first answer is returned and no version changes state twice

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the change and the answer reports the failure (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call that fails or does not answer
    When the change needs that call
    Then the change is not made and the answer reports the failure

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused and the version keeps its state (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given version 3 of "DEMAND-MTG" "TH" is withdrawn
    When LEG-0001 approves version 3 again
    Then the approval is refused and version 3 stays withdrawn
